description: M7 — Scheduled daily automation (tasks.md T7.1-T7.3). Reuse the CLI `run` subcommand (cli.py:main, unchanged) as the platform-agnostic Render-Cron / system-cron entrypoint that does ONE idempotent daily run for 'tomorrow' and exits. Add an OPTIONAL in-process APScheduler wrapper gated behind a new config flag defaulting OFF (no scheduler thread ever started in tests). Add a structured JSON run log that emits the orchestrator's existing RunReport counts. Add offline idempotency + change-detection tests over the fixture corpus. REUSES verbatim: pipeline.run, RunReport (target_date/fetched/merged/conflicts/cancelled/scored/history_entries), identity_key upsert (SqliteRepository.save_event + find_by_identity_key), Window.from_config, build_sources/default_fetcher, build_location_provider. This FEAT is independent of FEAT-002 and FEAT-003; it is ordered first because it adds the apscheduler dependency that FEAT-004 exports.
steps: In vandy_food_radar/config.py add a `SchedulerConfig` @dataclass (enabled: bool = False, hour: int = 6, minute: int = 0) and add `scheduler: SchedulerConfig = field(default_factory=SchedulerConfig)` to `Config`. In `Config.from_env` add VFR_SCHEDULER_ENABLED (via existing _parse_bool), VFR_SCHEDULER_HOUR and VFR_SCHEDULER_MINUTE overrides (add a small `_parse_int(value, default)` helper next to _parse_float, falling back to default on bad input, matching the module's robust-defaults pattern). Default stays OFF.
Run `uv add apscheduler` to add the dependency to pyproject.toml + uv.lock.

Add vandy_food_radar/pipeline/scheduler.py with `run_daily_once(*, db_path: str, config: Config) -> RunReport` that reproduces cli.py:main's wiring exactly — SqliteRepository(db_path), default_fetcher(config), build_sources(config, fetcher), Window.from_config(config, today=datetime.now(tz=UTC).date()), build_location_provider(config) — calls pipeline.run(...), logs the RunReport via runlog (step from FEAT-001 runlog), closes the repository in a finally, and returns the RunReport. Add `start_scheduler(*, db_path: str, config: Config) -> BackgroundScheduler | None` that returns None (starting nothing) when `config.scheduler.enabled` is False, else constructs an apscheduler BackgroundScheduler with a cron trigger at config.scheduler.hour/minute calling run_daily_once and returns it. Import apscheduler lazily inside start_scheduler so a disabled path needs no import side effects.

Add vandy_food_radar/pipeline/runlog.py with `run_report_to_json(report: RunReport) -> str` returning json.dumps of {target_date (isoformat), fetched, merged, conflicts, cancelled, scored, history_entries} with sort_keys=True, and `log_run_report(report: RunReport, *, stream: TextIO = sys.stdout) -> None` that prints run_report_to_json to the stream. Type stream as typing.TextIO.
Update vandy_food_radar/pipeline/__init__.py to export run_daily_once, start_scheduler, run_report_to_json, log_run_report (keep existing run, seed_demo, RunReport exports).

In vandy_food_radar/cli.py, after the existing run/seed print, additionally emit the structured JSON line via pipeline.log_run_report(report) so the CLI `run` used by Render Cron produces the observable run log (T7.3). Keep the human-readable print too. Do not change the subcommand surface.

Add tests/test_runlog.py: assert run_report_to_json(RunReport(...)) is valid JSON containing all 7 keys (target_date, fetched, merged, conflicts, cancelled, scored, history_entries) with the exact counts set on the report.

Add tests/test_scheduler.py using SqliteRepository(':memory:') is not possible across two connections, so use a tmp_path db file: (a) run_daily_once twice over an offline single-source adapter and assert no duplicate events (E-9 late-add idempotency via identity_key upsert); (b) reuse the _SingleRecordAdapter change-detection pattern from tests/test_pipeline_e2e.py to assert a time change (E-2) and venue change (E-3) update in place with exactly one history row each; (c) assert a cancelled fixture event yields verification_state CANCELLED with a single cancellation history row across repeated runs (E-4); (d) assert start_scheduler returns None and starts no thread when config.scheduler.enabled is False (the default).
acceptance_criteria: Config().scheduler.enabled is False by default; Config.from_env honors VFR_SCHEDULER_ENABLED/_HOUR/_MINUTE.
start_scheduler returns None (no BackgroundScheduler thread) when scheduler disabled; tests leave no running scheduler thread.
run_report_to_json emits exactly the 7 RunReport count keys as valid JSON.
Running the pipeline twice for the same target day creates no duplicate events and appends history only for changed fields (idempotency preserved via existing identity_key upsert).
`make check` is green (ruff, black --check, mypy strict, pytest all pass).
